summary: Third Point Private Capital Partners filed an 8-K under Items 3.02 and 8.01 reporting an unregistered sale of 384,766 Class I common shares for $10,000,000 in aggregate consideration, closed as of May 1, 2026 with the final share count determined on June 16, 2026. The sale was exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S, relying on accredited-investor or non-U.S. person representations. The filing also disclosed an April 30, 2026 NAV per share of $25.99, with no Class S or D shares outstanding. This is a routine capital raise by a closed-end fund, not a special situation.
